intelligence.human_view: A signature is the one thing people see and remember — and the heart is the signature. Red was the past: a ruby heart, beautiful, but any heart can be red. Purple is royal, the crown color, the color of NayaNET itself — and when people see the purple heart, they know whose it is before they read a word. Only the color changes: the heart stays a real 3D jewel, press in, release out, alive — because the object was right, and only its color was wrong. This is the same law as the ball and the 3D object (SN-3178, SN-3181) applied to the one symbol that matters most: keep the jewel, change the color, make it unmistakably ours.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine every love heart in the whole world is red — and then one special purple heart appears, royal purple like a crown jewel. When you see the purple heart, you know exactly whose it is. That is the signature. The heart stays a real jewel you can press — only its color changes, to purple.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, the little love heart is going to be purple now — a royal purple jewel, the crown color, the signature of the whole place. The red heart was lovely, but red hearts are everywhere; a purple heart is the one people see and remember. It stays a real jewel, pressing in when you touch it and springing back out — only the color changes.
intelligence.naya_view: LOVE'S HEART IS PURPLE — A PURPLE JEWEL HEART, ROYAL PURPLE, THE CROWN COLOR — THE SIGNATURE OF NAYANET. THE RED HEART IS THE PAST.
